title: Waggle
tagline: Read a honeybee's dance and find the flowers.
how_to: Watch the dancing bee, work out the bearing and distance, tap the map to drop a pin, then send the foragers. No sound.
description: A forager bee dances on the honeycomb: the angle of her waggle run from vertical is the flowers' angle from the sun, and its length in time is the distance. Turn that into a spot on the meadow map over five rounds, with optional protractor and ruler guides. The sun moves between rounds, so you must re-do the sum.
spark: Bees taken literally: the real waggle dance code, turned into a decoding puzzle.
proud_of: The dance itself: a wiggling figure-eight with trailing gold dust, whose run length and timing really encode the answer.
